_comment: Detection configuration. Every number here is a hand-assigned heuristic, not a probability and not fitted to labelled data. A rule 'weight' (0-1) says how strongly that rule alone counts as evidence; it is not impact severity. Edit and call POST /api/detection/reload, or restart. Override the path with DETECTION_RULES_PATH. Risk-band thresholds are NOT here: they are chosen on validation runs and recorded in backend/operating_point.json.

scoring._note: risk_score = 100 x (rules x rule_evidence + ml x anomaly). Stage, correlation and baseline are deliberately not added: they restate the rule evidence. Stage count gates the band (min_stages_*).

unfamiliar_ip.description: Activity from an IP address not part of the employee's baseline

off_hours_login.description: Login outside business hours by an employee who rarely works after hours

failed_login_burst.description: Multiple failed logins in a short period

admin_console_login_failed.description: Failed login against the administrator console

access_denied.description: Access denied (own department or insufficient privilege level)

unauthorised_department_access.description: Attempt to access another department's classified resource without permission

restricted_denied.description: Denied attempt on a restricted-classification resource with no permission

sensitive_access_novel.description: First access to a restricted resource outside the employee's normal duties

rapid_enumeration.description: Rapid access to many different classified resources

large_export.description: Large data export or download well above the employee's baseline

removable_media_copy.description: Records of a classified resource copied to removable media (halved when below the bulk threshold)

unusual_outbound_transfer.description: Outbound transfer to an external destination that is unusual for this employee

external_transfer_confirmed.description: Confirmed transfer of records to an external destination

permission_change_attempt.description: Attempt to change permissions or perform an administrative action without authority

new_account_login.description: Login by an account created within the last day by another user
